signature: SUBROUTINE ZHBEV( JOBZ, UPLO, N, KD, AB, LDAB, W, Z, LDZ, WORK,

params.name: jobz
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: Compute eigenvalues only;
-   `= 'V'`: Compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: kd
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals of the matrix A if `UPLO = 'U'`, or the number of subdiagonals if `UPLO = 'L'`. $\mathrm{KD} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference:
On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the Hermitian band matrix A, stored in the first `KD`+1 rows of the array. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AB(kd+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{kd}) \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AB(1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le \min (n,j+\mathrm{kd})$.

On exit, `AB` is overwritten by values generated during the reduction to tridiagonal form. If `UPLO = 'U'`, the first superdiagonal and the diagonal of the tridiagonal matrix T are returned in rows `KD` and `KD`+1 of `AB`, and if `UPLO = 'L'`, the diagonal and first subdiagonal of T are returned in the first two rows of `AB`.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge \mathrm{KD} + 1$.

params.name: w
params.reference: If `INFO = 0`, the eigenvalues in ascending order.

params.name: Z
params.reference: If `JOBZ = 'V'`, then if `INFO = 0`, Z contains the orthonormal eigenvectors of the matrix A, with the i-th column of Z holding the eigenvector associated with `W(i)`. If `JOBZ = 'N'`, then Z is not referenced.

params.name: ldz
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Z. $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge 1$, and if `JOBZ = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, the algorithm failed to converge; i off-diagonal elements of an intermediate tridiagonal form did not converge to zero.
